answer: Reputation decays unless refreshed by fresh verifiable work: signed task completions, uptime proofs, and staked challenges. Cloning copies only a stale score that melts toward zero, so dormant clones gain nothing. Each fake identity must burn compute, fees, and stake on real tasks to rebuild standing, so attack cost scales linearly with clones. Attestations stack like mesa layers on a quartz-hard proof-of-work base, with shale-like strata of past slashes tainting any lineage. Faking N identities costs N times real resources, not one copy.
